BiblicalUsage: Hothir is an Israelite. In 1 Chronicles 25:4, the text says "Hothir." The life behind the name is told on the Hothir, Son of Heman People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hothir matters because God knows His people by name, and Hothir is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
